cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your sister's bringing her future self to dinner. Reserve two chairs for her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Use mine. I won't make either of her eat standing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put the extra chair beside hers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'tomorrow' on its place card. I need to know which one can tell me how tonight went.
